## Evidence rules

1. Each source proves only what it records.
2. Primary and authoritative sources are preferred.
3. Inclusion records a documented contribution or measurable influence route, not total endorsement.
4. Pending cases, allegations and disputed claims remain explicitly labelled.
5. Structural tools and durable public-interest work rank above rhetoric alone.

The complete person-by-person source list is available in the public research ledger and the four canonical suit files.
